test_eos_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset with eos break mode to split sequences at end-of-sequence tokens
test_block_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset with block break mode to split sequences into fixed-size blocks
test_complete_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset with complete break mode to keep sequences intact within block size limits
test_4billion_tokens: test the TokenBlockDataset with 4 billion tokens to verify numpy uint64 overflow handling
build_token_block_dataset: build a TokenBlockDataset from torch tensors with configurable block size, pad, eos, and break mode
